posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Right, so, if there's a computer plus webcam available for people to possibly use over there, I have a simple plan that should work.

I set up a generic G+ account, which doesn't belong to anyone and thus avoids potential issues of privacy, etc. You guys over there sign in to that account, I do a G+ hangout and the generic account and other virtuals join. That way people can pop in and out and chat and maybe even play an online game, and we can virtually meet. Sound sensible? Anyone up for that?

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Silverleaf:

Right, so, if there's a computer plus webcam available for people to possibly use over there, I have a simple plan that should work.I set up a generic G+ account, which doesn't belong to anyone and thus avoids potential issues of privacy, etc. You guys over there sign in to that account, I do a G+ hangout and the generic account and other virtuals join. That way people can pop in and out and chat and maybe even play an online game, and we can virtually meet. Sound sensible? Anyone up for that?

 

I have no privacy concerns. I could just log in from my own account.

 

My concerns are (1) That we won't have a computer located in a useful place. Is there wirelessin the building? Is it any good? If not, where/how can we run Ethernet? Is there a computer w/ decent processing power? And a web cam? And some reasonable way to keep it from going to a screen saver if no one is attending it?

(2) What would be useful to actually do with that computer? Mixing a live party w/ an online party is a difficult proposition, I think. Those of us who are there are going to be interacting with each other and I think that interacting with the computer will, after a few moments of novetly, prove more distracting than fun.

Both of the above might be helped by discussing and coordinating with the GtGs guys, but the reality is that they are too busy.

 

I think a nice idea would be that instead of trying to add a remote interaction component to the Vengeance release part, GTGs might want to do a later, public hangout w/ whomever wants to join as a sort of second, online Vengeance hangout. They might do some sort of demo of Vengeance. They might have a device that allowed them to walk around and show off their offices or the warehouse.
